episode.name: md_company_batch_bigtech_2026-05-16
episode.source_desc: Batch episode covering Alibaba, Baidu, Tencent, Xiaomi, iFlytek, Foxconn, HorizonRobotics, Midea — one source per entity

entities.name: Alibaba
entities.summary: Alibaba Group (HKEX:9988 / NYSE:BABA). China's largest e-commerce + cloud + digital-infrastructure conglomerate. FY26 (ending Mar-2026): revenue ¥1,023.7 bn (USD 148.4 bn), op income ¥50.2 bn, net profit ¥102.1 bn. Adj EBITA ¥105.9 bn, FCF ¥46.6 bn. Cash & investments ¥520.8 bn (USD 75.5 bn) — one of world's most cash-rich tech issuers. ~194k employees after divesting Sun Art / Intime. Strategic investor in Unitree.

entities.name: Baidu
entities.summary: Baidu Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU / HKEX:9888). China's largest Chinese-language internet search company; one of the four 'AI national team' members alongside Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance. FY2025 revenue ¥129.1 bn (USD 18.5 bn, -3% yoy). Baidu General Business (search + Baidu AI Cloud + Apollo Go / Robotaxi) + iQIYI long-video subsidiary. Apollo Go: 20 m+ paid rides cumulative, 26 cities, partners with Uber and Lyft for overseas. Stack: Kunlun AI accelerator, PaddlePaddle DL framework, ERNIE 4.5/5.0 LLM, Qianfan MaaS.

entities.name: Tencent
entities.summary: Tencent Holdings (HKEX:0700). China's biggest internet services conglomerate; 1.4 bn MAU WeChat super-app. FY2024 revenue ¥660.3 bn (+8%), gross profit ¥355.1 bn (53.8% margin), non-IFRS net profit ¥222.7 bn (+41%). Largest games revenue globally; owns Riot Games and Supercell; minority stakes in Epic Games, Krafton, Ubisoft, FromSoftware, Tesla, Snap, Spotify, Sea, Meituan, Pinduoduo, JD.com, Kuaishou + dozens of robotics/AI startups. Strategic investor in Agibot and Unitree.

entities.name: ByteDance
entities.summary: ByteDance — TikTok / Douyin operator; one of China's 'AI national team' alongside Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu. Private; not separately covered by a report.

entities.name: Riot Games
entities.summary: Tencent wholly-owned games studio (League of Legends).

entities.name: Supercell
entities.summary: Tencent wholly-owned mobile-games studio (Clash of Clans).

entities.name: Epic Games
entities.summary: US games developer; Tencent minority stake.

entities.name: iQIYI
entities.summary: iQIYI (NASDAQ:IQ). Baidu-controlled long-video streaming subsidiary; consolidated in Baidu group accounts.

entities.name: Apollo Go
entities.summary: 萝卜快跑. Baidu's Robotaxi service — 20 m+ paid rides cumulative; 26 cities including Beijing, Wuhan, Hong Kong, Abu Dhabi, Dubai. Uber and Lyft partnerships for overseas expansion.

entities.name: ERNIE
entities.summary: 文心 4.5 / 5.0. Baidu's foundation-model family.

entities.name: Kunlun Chip
entities.summary: Baidu's in-house AI accelerator chip family.

entities.name: Xiaomi
entities.summary: Xiaomi Corporation (HKEX:1810). Top-3 global smartphone maker + leading AIoT ecosystem + profitable EV business (SU7 / YU7). 'Human × Car × Home' strategy on unified HyperOS stack. Five-pillar group: smartphones, IoT, internet services, smart EV, plus emerging robotics / advanced manufacturing. Self-developed Xring O1 3nm SoC reduces Qualcomm/MediaTek dependence. Strategic investor in Unitree via Shunwei Capital (Lei Jun affiliated).

entities.name: Xiaomi SU7
entities.summary: Xiaomi SU7 sedan — Xiaomi's first EV (launched 2024).

entities.name: Xiaomi YU7
entities.summary: Xiaomi YU7 SUV (launched mid-2025) — second Xiaomi EV.

entities.name: HyperOS
entities.summary: Xiaomi HyperOS — unified software stack across phones, home appliances and cars.

entities.name: Xring O1
entities.summary: 玄戒 O1. Xiaomi self-developed 3nm SoC — first flagship SoC reducing Qualcomm/MediaTek dependence.

entities.name: iFlytek
entities.summary: 科大讯飞 (SZSE:002230). China's leading speech / NLP AI company headquartered in Hefei. Vertically integrated AI platform: in-house multimodal LLM (讯飞星火 / Spark), enterprise vertical AI apps, consumer AI hardware, AI Open Platform (10.7m+ registered developers). Re-listed on US Entity List (2019, again 2023) — pushed full-stack migration to Huawei Ascend domestic compute. FY2025 revenue ¥27 bn.

entities.name: iFlytek Spark
entities.summary: 讯飞星火 / Spark. iFlytek's multimodal foundation model family.

entities.name: Huawei Ascend
entities.summary: 华为昇腾. Huawei's AI-accelerator family; the dominant domestic-compute alternative for AI training in China.

entities.name: Foxconn
entities.summary: 鸿海精密工业 / Foxconn (TWSE:2317). World's largest electronics contract manufacturer; Apple's single most important industrial supplier. FY2025 revenue NTD 8.10 trillion (~USD 257 bn, +18.1% yoy) — first year over NTD 8 tn. Net profit NTD 189.4 bn (+24%). Group owns Industrial Fulian (FII, SSE:601138 — AI-server pure play), FIH Mobile (HKEX) and Foxtron Vehicle Technologies (TPEx:2258 — EV JV). Builds iPhones, AirPods, NVIDIA AI-server racks, network switches, game consoles, and increasingly full EVs. Disclosed 2025 Agibot humanoid pilot.

entities.name: Industrial Fulian
entities.summary: 工业富联 (FII, SSE:601138). Foxconn's Shanghai-listed AI-server / cloud-infrastructure pure-play subsidiary.

entities.name: Foxtron Vehicle Technologies
entities.summary: 鸿华先进 (TPEx:2258). Foxconn's EV-manufacturing JV.

entities.name: FIH Mobile
entities.summary: 富智康集团. Foxconn's HKEX-listed smartphone-component subsidiary.

entities.name: Horizon Robotics
entities.summary: 地平线机器人 (HKEX:9660). China leader in passenger-car ADAS / AD silicon + software. Designs Journey (征程) automotive AI SoCs in-house; software stacks Horizon Mono / Pilot / SuperDrive (HSD). Self-described as 'China's Mobileye + NVIDIA' — vertically integrated chip + software + IP licensing.

entities.name: Journey SoC
entities.summary: 征程 series — Horizon Robotics' automotive AI SoCs (Journey 2/3/5/6) for ADAS up to highway NOA up to urban AD.

entities.name: Mobileye
entities.summary: Israeli ADAS-silicon leader (Intel-listed). Reference comparable for Horizon Robotics.

entities.name: Midea
entities.summary: 美的集团 (SZSE:000333). World's largest home-appliance maker by unit volume + top-3 global industrial-robot maker via German subsidiary KUKA. FY2025 'ToB' (building tech + robotics + industrial tech + new energy + medical imaging + supply-chain logistics) revenue ¥122.8 bn (+17.5%). ~66% revenue still ToC home appliances. >140 m connected smart appliances; >150 m registered smart-home users. Anpeilong customer; humanoid investor.

entities.name: KUKA
entities.summary: Midea-owned German industrial-robot maker — top-3 global industrial robot OEM.

entities.summary: Toshiba — appliance brand licensed by Midea Group.
